description: Starting decklists (Sean, Special Goobs.xlsx 2026-11-27: built by rarity, not family). Each: 1 legendary, 4 very rare, 7 rare + 9 plain Goobs = 21. Each scenario both sides get a different list, or sometimes a random deck with the same shape (DeckBuilder.RANDOM_CHANCE). Ids = GoobDefinition.id.

decklists.name: Wrecking Crew
decklists.plan: Loyal shields your Goobs, so Volatile and Desperate only hurt him; Inspiring re-fires a destroy; Occult brings back what you lost; Greedy and Fickle dig for Crushing and Loyal.

decklists.name: Shove and Copy
decklists.plan: Pushes and rolls break up enemy lines; Stalwart and Steadfast anchor your own Goobs; Nostalgic and Inspiring repeat a push; Fickle discards Defiant for a free drop, Thrifty revives a discard.

decklists.name: Bottomless Pockets
decklists.plan: Plentiful and Greedy keep the hand full; Reckless, Fickle, Ruthless and Desperate turn spare Goobs into value; Defiant drops when discarded; Thrifty returns the best discard; Jinxing and Distracting starve him.

decklists.name: Hold the Line
decklists.plan: Denial: Territorial closes his best column, Stalwart, Loyal and Steadfast keep your four intact, Hoarding protects your hand, Stifling, Distracting and Jinxing blunt his turns, Thieving takes his passives.

decklists.name: Tremors
decklists.plan: Chaos: Seismic, Sinking and Rowdy rearrange the whole board; Steadfast pins your Goobs while his slide; Bouncy and Slippery send his Goobs astray; Occult and Volatile clean up.

decklists.name: Crowd Pleaser
decklists.plan: Board presence: Popular drops two Goobs, Inspiring next to it drops another, Occult and Thrifty bring Goobs back; Greedy and Fickle find Popular; Brawling and Fat clear his blockers.

decklists.name: Turncoat
decklists.plan: Take what is his: Convincing flips a Goob, Inspiring flips another, Mocking copies his best play, Thieving steals his passives; Spiteful and Brawling punish stacking.

decklists.name: Slow Harvest
decklists.plan: Generous on the board draws every turn, guarded by Loyal, Stalwart and Steadfast; Hoarding keeps the hand safe; Jinxing and Stifling slow him while you out-draw him.
